findings.title: Missing idempotency key in webhook call
findings.body: The webhook handler calls `record_payment` without the new `idempotency_key` parameter, so the idempotency check added in this PR is bypassed. The call on line 18 must include `data["idempotency_key"]` to ensure duplicate events are handled correctly.

findings.title: Payment.create called with idempotency_key but not used in save
findings.body: `Payment.create` now accepts an `idempotency_key`, but the `save` function does not persist it. The idempotency key must be stored in the database to ensure future calls to `find_by_key` can retrieve the correct payment. Update `save` to include the key in the persisted data.

summary.problem: Idempotency is partially implemented: the recording function checks for existing payments, but the webhook call omits the key and the save function does not persist it.
summary.done_well: The idempotency check in `record_payment` prevents duplicate payments from being created when the same key is reused.
